source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Joshua 1–8 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 186 original source records are bound exactly once.

delta_method: F0 retained wording; F1 lexical; F2 syntax/idiom; F3 consequential interpretive, textual, social, or versification choice. Editorial assessments are separate from similarity scores. No minimum-change quota. Independent review has not occurred.

verses.rationale: Opens with a direct temporal clause and identifies both relationships before the speech.
verses.before: After the death of Moses, servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,
verses.after: After Moses, the LORD’s servant, died, the LORD said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant:
verses.tsw_comparator: After the death of Moses, servant of the LORD, the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying,

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated death notice and collective crossing command; names the recipients of the land.
verses.before: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I am giving to them, to the children of Israel.
verses.after: “My servant Moses is dead. Now get up and cross this Jordan, you and all these people, into the land I am giving them—the Israelites.
verses.tsw_comparator: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I am giving to them, to the children of Israel.

verses.rationale: Retains the foot image and completed gift language within the prospective commission.
verses.before: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads I have given to you, just as I spoke to Moses.
verses.after: I have given you every place the sole of your foot steps on, just as I promised Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: Every place on which the sole of your foot treads I have given to you, just as I spoke to Moses.

verses.rationale: Places the territorial subject first while preserving every boundary and the Hittite land.
verses.before: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the Euphrates River—all the land of the Hittites—and as far as the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun will be your territory.
verses.after: Your territory will stretch from the wilderness and this Lebanon to the great river, the Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and to the Great Sea in the west.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the Euphrates River—all the land of the Hittites—and as far as the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun shall be your territory.

verses.rationale: Breaks the assurance into audible clauses and retains the paired refusal to release or forsake.
verses.before: No one will stand before you all the days of your life. Just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you or abandon you.
verses.after: No one will be able to stand against you as long as you live. As I was with Moses, I will be with you. I will not let you go or abandon you.
verses.tsw_comparator: No one shall stand before you all the days of your life. Just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not fail you or abandon you.

verses.rationale: Connects courage to the causative inheritance task and the ancestral oath.
verses.before: Be strong and courageous, for you will cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their ancestors to give them.
verses.after: Be strong and courageous, for you will lead these people into possession of the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Be strong and courageous, for you shall cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their ancestors to give them.

verses.rationale: Keeps the intensification, all-instruction scope, path image, and wisdom/success connection.
verses.before: Only be strong and very courageous, being careful to do according to all the instruction that Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may act wisely wherever you go.
verses.after: Only be strong and very courageous. Carefully carry out all the instruction my servant Moses commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or the left, so that you may act wisely wherever you go.
verses.tsw_comparator: Only be strong and very courageous, being careful to do according to all the instruction that Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may act wisely wherever you go.

verses.rationale: Unfolds hagah’s spoken reflection with a note; retains the mouth image and obedience as purpose, not silent thought alone.
verses.before: This book of instruction will not depart from your mouth. You will meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will act wisely.
verses.after: Keep this scroll of instruction on your lips. Recite it and reflect on it day and night, so that you carefully do everything written in it. Then you will make your way prosper; then you will act wisely.
verses.tsw_comparator: This book of instruction shall not depart from your mouth. You shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will act wisely.

verses.rationale: Preserves the rhetorical question, third-person divine self-reference, and recurring courage refrain.
verses.before: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
verses.after: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified or discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

verses.rationale: Names the administrative audience and makes the speech introduction direct.
verses.before: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.after: Joshua gave the people’s officers these orders:
verses.tsw_comparator: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

verses.rationale: Retains the three-day announcement and repeated possession language without inventing a harmonized timetable.
verses.before: “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you are to cross this Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’”
verses.after: “Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Get your provisions ready. In three days you will cross this Jordan to take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’”
verses.tsw_comparator: “Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you are to cross this Jordan to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess.’”

verses.rationale: Preserves the three specified groups and limits Manasseh to its half-tribe.
verses.before: To the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshua said,
verses.after: To the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said:
verses.tsw_comparator: To the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshua said,

verses.rationale: Distinguishes the rest being given from the land already given and keeps Moses’ quoted command.
verses.before: “Remember the word that Moses, servant of the LORD, commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God is giving you rest and has given you this land.’
verses.after: “Remember what Moses, the LORD’s servant, commanded you: ‘The LORD your God is giving you rest and has given you this land.’
verses.tsw_comparator: “Remember the word that Moses, servant of the LORD, commanded you, saying, ‘The LORD your God is giving you rest and has given you this land.’

verses.rationale: Resolves brothers as fellow Israelites while retaining the male warriors, wives, children, and livestock.
verses.before: Your wives, your little children, and your livestock will remain in the land that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan. But all your warriors will cross over armed before your brothers and help them,
verses.after: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock may stay in the land Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But all your mighty warriors must cross over armed ahead of your fellow Israelites and help them,
verses.tsw_comparator: Your wives, your little children, and your livestock shall remain in the land that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan. But all your warriors shall cross over armed before your brothers and help them,

verses.rationale: Lets the obligation continue across the verse boundary and preserves the reciprocal rest and eastern location.
verses.before: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as to you, and they also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you will return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses, servant of the LORD, gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.”
verses.after: until the LORD gives them rest as he has given you, and they too possess the land the LORD your God is giving them. Then you may return to your own land and possess it—the land Moses, the LORD’s servant, gave you east of the Jordan.”
verses.tsw_comparator: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as to you, and they also possess the land that the LORD your God is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and possess it, which Moses, servant of the LORD, gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the eastern groups as speakers and the two parallel commitments.
verses.before: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
verses.after: They answered Joshua, “We will do everything you have commanded us and go wherever you send us.
verses.tsw_comparator: They answered Joshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

verses.rationale: Leaves their claim about former obedience uncorrected and renders the final clause as a wish rather than an added condition.
verses.before: Just as we listened to Moses in everything, so we will listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.
verses.after: We will obey you just as we obeyed Moses in everything. Only may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses!
verses.tsw_comparator: Just as we listened to Moses in everything, so we will listen to you. Only may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.

verses.rationale: Retains the lethal sanction in the people’s speech and their repetition of the commission refrain.
verses.before: Whoever rebels against your command and does not listen to your words in all that you command will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”
verses.after: Anyone who rebels against your orders and refuses to obey whatever you command is to be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!”
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever rebels against your command and does not listen to your words in all that you command shall be put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

verses.rationale: Makes the secret mission clear; preserves Rahab’s occupation without adding a sexual encounter to their lodging.
verses.before: Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, see the land, especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a woman, a prostitute, whose name was Rahab, and they lodged there.
verses.after: Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Shittim to spy out the land. “Go and look over the land, especially Jericho,” he told them. They went to the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.
verses.tsw_comparator: Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two men from Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, see the land, especially Jericho.” So they went and entered the house of a woman, a prostitute, whose name was Rahab, and they lodged there.

verses.rationale: Keeps the report’s tonight and reconnaissance purpose in direct speech.
verses.before: It was told to the king of Jericho, saying, “Look, men from the children of Israel have come here tonight to search out the land.”
verses.after: Word reached the king of Jericho: “Some Israelite men came here tonight to search out the land.”
verses.tsw_comparator: It was told to the king of Jericho, saying, “Look, men from the children of Israel have come here tonight to search out the land.”

verses.rationale: Makes sending a message idiomatic and retains the repeated accusation of reconnaissance.
verses.before: Then the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who came to you, who entered your house, for they have come to search out all the land.”
verses.after: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: “Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house. They have come to search out the whole land.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, “Bring out the men who came to you, who entered your house, for they have come to search out all the land.”

verses.rationale: Uses the two men as the contextual object of the singular Hebrew suffix; preserves the contrast between concealment and her report.
verses.before: But the woman took the two men and hid them. She said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
verses.after: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the woman took the two men and hid them. She said, “Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.

verses.rationale: Keeps her false account as her own speech and preserves gate timing and pursuit urgency.
verses.before: When the gate was about to be shut at dark, the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you may overtake them.”
verses.after: At dark, when the gate was about to close, they left. I do not know where they went. Hurry after them—you can catch them!”
verses.tsw_comparator: When the gate was about to be shut at dark, the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you may overtake them.”

verses.rationale: Marks the narrator’s return to what happened and retains the specific hiding material and roof.
verses.before: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had arranged on the roof.
verses.after: She had actually taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out there.
verses.tsw_comparator: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax that she had arranged on the roof.

verses.rationale: Identifies the pursuers rather than confusing them with the spies; keeps the fords and gate sequence.
verses.before: So the men pursued them along the road to the Jordan as far as the fords. As soon as people who pursued them had gone out, the gate was shut.
verses.after: The pursuers went after them along the road to the Jordan’s crossing places. As soon as the pursuers left, the gate was shut.
verses.tsw_comparator: So the men pursued them along the road to the Jordan as far as the fords. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, the gate was shut.

verses.rationale: Names the approaching speaker and retains the before-sleep timing.
verses.before: Before the spies lay down, she came up to them on the roof.
verses.after: Before the two men lay down, Rahab went up to them on the roof.
verses.tsw_comparator: Before the spies lay down, she came up to them on the roof.

verses.rationale: Retains her knowledge claim, falling terror, and melting image that returns in the spies’ report.
verses.before: She said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that terror of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
verses.after: She said, “I know the LORD has given you the land. Terror of you has fallen on us, and everyone who lives in the land is melting with fear because of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: She said to the men, “I know that the LORD has given you the land, and that terror of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.

verses.rationale: Keeps the Exodus link and herem’s destruction rather than reducing it to victory; Sea of Reeds follows the Hebrew name.
verses.before: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Sea of Reeds before you when you came out from Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you devoted to destruction.
verses.after: We heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Sea of Reeds before you when you left Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan whom you devoted to destruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Sea of Reeds before you when you came out from Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you devoted to destruction.

verses.rationale: Preserves heart and spirit images and the full heaven/earth confession.
verses.before: When we heard it, our hearts melted, and no spirit remained in anyone because of you. For the LORD your God—he is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.
verses.after: When we heard it, our hearts melted, and no one had any spirit left to face you. For the LORD your God is God in heaven above and on earth below.
verses.tsw_comparator: When we heard it, our hearts melted, and no spirit remained in anyone because of you. For the LORD your God—he is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.

verses.rationale: Keeps reciprocal hesed and the request for a reliable sign; the sentence continues into the requested rescue.
verses.before: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have shown you steadfast love, that you also will show steadfast love to my father’s house. Give me a reliable sign
verses.after: Now please swear to me by the LORD that, since I have shown you loyal kindness, you too will show loyal kindness to my father’s household. Give me a trustworthy sign
verses.tsw_comparator: Now therefore, please swear to me by the LORD, since I have shown you steadfast love, that you also will show steadfast love to my father’s house. Give me a reliable sign

verses.rationale: Preserves every family category, plural sisters in the reading tradition, and the explicit threat of death.
verses.before: that you will preserve alive my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and everyone who belong to them, and rescue our lives from death.”
verses.after: that you will spare my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and rescue our lives from death.”
verses.tsw_comparator: that you will preserve alive my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and all who belong to them, and rescue our lives from death.”

verses.rationale: Preserves the life-for-life pledge, confidentiality condition, and paired hesed/emeth rather than general gratitude.
verses.before: The men said to her, “Our lives for yours, even to death, if you do not tell this matter of ours. When the LORD gives us the land, we will deal with you in steadfast love and faithfulness.”
verses.after: The men answered her, “Our lives for yours, even to death! If you do not reveal our mission, we will show you loyal kindness and faithfulness when the LORD gives us the land.”
verses.tsw_comparator: The men said to her, “Our lives for yours, even to death, if you do not tell this matter of ours. When the LORD gives us the land, we will deal with you in steadfast love and faithfulness.”

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated wall location and rope escape without architectural reconstruction.
verses.before: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was in the city wall, and she lived in the wall.
verses.after: She lowered them by a rope through the window, for her house was built into the city wall; she lived in the wall itself.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was in the city wall, and she lived in the wall.

verses.rationale: Retains Rahab’s tactical direction and the specific three-day hiding interval.
verses.before: She said to them, “Go toward the hill country, lest the pursuers meet you. Hide yourselves there three days until the pursuers return. Afterward you may go your way.”
verses.after: “Go to the hills,” she told them, “so the pursuers will not find you. Hide there for three days until they come back; then you can go on your way.”
verses.tsw_comparator: She said to them, “Go toward the hill country, lest the pursuers meet you. Hide yourselves there three days until the pursuers return. Afterward you may go your way.”

verses.rationale: Introduces the following conditions audibly without presenting release from the oath as unconditional.
verses.before: The men said to her, “We will be free from this oath of yours that you made us swear
verses.after: The men told her, “We will be free of this oath you made us swear unless you do this:
verses.tsw_comparator: The men said to her, “We will be free from this oath of yours that you made us swear

verses.rationale: Keeps the cord, window, entry timing, and complete household gathering as terms of the oath.
verses.before: unless, when we enter the land, you tie this cord of scarlet thread in the window through which you let us down, and gather to yourself in the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
verses.after: when we enter the land, tie this scarlet cord in the window you lowered us through, and gather your father, mother, brothers, and your father’s entire household into your house.
verses.tsw_comparator: unless, when we enter the land, you tie this cord of scarlet thread in the window through which you let us down, and gather to yourself in the house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.

verses.rationale: Retains the blood-on-heads responsibility image and differentiates those outside from those protected inside.
verses.before: Whoever goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head, and we will be innocent. But whoever is with you in the house, his blood will be on our head if a hand is laid upon him.
verses.after: If anyone goes outside the doors of your house, their blood will be on their own head, and we will be free of guilt. But if a hand is laid on anyone with you inside the house, their blood will be on our heads.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whoever goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be on his own head, and we shall be innocent. But whoever is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head if a hand is laid upon him.

verses.rationale: Preserves the repeated confidentiality condition as a separate closing stipulation.
verses.before: But if you tell this matter of ours, then we will be free from your oath that you made us swear.”
verses.after: If you reveal our mission, we will be free of the oath you made us swear.”
verses.tsw_comparator: But if you tell this matter of ours, then we shall be free from your oath that you made us swear.”

verses.rationale: Keeps her acceptance, dismissal, and tying of the sign in the narrated order.
verses.before: She said, “According to your words, so be it.” Then she sent them away, and they went. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.after: “Let it be as you say,” she replied. She sent them away, and they left. Then she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.tsw_comparator: She said, “According to your words, so be it.” Then she sent them away, and they went. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

verses.rationale: Retains the completed hiding interval and unsuccessful search without moving it elsewhere in the chronology.
verses.before: They departed and went into the hill country and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. The pursuers searched all along the road but did not find them.
verses.after: They went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers returned. The pursuers searched all along the road but never found the spies.
verses.tsw_comparator: They departed and went into the hill country and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. The pursuers searched all along the road but did not find them.

verses.rationale: Makes the return itinerary and comprehensive report easy to follow.
verses.before: Then the two men returned. They came down from the hill country, crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.
verses.after: Then the two men came back down from the hills, crossed the river, and went to Joshua son of Nun. They told him everything that had happened to them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the two men returned. They came down from the hill country, crossed over, and came to Joshua son of Nun. They told him all that had happened to them.

verses.rationale: Retains hand and melting images and the echo of Rahab’s words in the spies’ report.
verses.before: They said to Joshua, “Truly the LORD has given all the land into our hand. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”
verses.after: “The LORD really has given the whole land into our hands,” they told Joshua. “Everyone living there is melting with fear because of us.”
verses.tsw_comparator: They said to Joshua, “Truly the LORD has given all the land into our hand. Moreover, all the inhabitants of the land melt away before us.”

verses.rationale: Separates departure from overnight lodging and preserves the entire people as travelers.
verses.before: Joshua rose early in the morning, and he and all the sons of Israel set out from Shittim. They came to the Jordan and lodged there before they crossed over.
verses.after: Joshua rose early in the morning. He and all the Israelites left Shittim and came to the Jordan, where they spent the night before crossing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Joshua rose early in the morning, and he and all the sons of Israel set out from Shittim. They came to the Jordan and lodged there before they crossed over.

verses.rationale: Keeps the distinct three-day notice and continues the action into the command.
verses.before: And it happened at the end of three days that the officers passed through the midst of the camp
verses.after: At the end of three days, the officers went through the camp
verses.tsw_comparator: And it happened at the end of three days that the officers passed through the midst of the camp

verses.rationale: Preserves the covenant title and Levitical identification of the carriers.
verses.before: and commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God and the Levitical priests bearing it, then you will set out from your place and go after it.
verses.after: and gave the people these orders: “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God being carried by the Levitical priests, leave your places and follow it.
verses.tsw_comparator: and commanded the people, saying, “When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God and the Levitical priests bearing it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.

verses.rationale: Keeps the approximate ancient measurement and unfamiliar-way purpose without replacing cubits with false precision.
verses.before: Yet there will be a distance between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you will go, for you have not passed this way before.”
verses.after: Keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between you and the ark. Do not go near it. Then you will know which way to go, for you have never traveled this way before.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet there shall be a distance between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you shall go, for you have not passed this way before.”

verses.rationale: Retains consecration as biblical vocabulary and the tomorrow/among-you promise.
verses.before: Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders in your midst.”
verses.after: Joshua told the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders among you.”
verses.tsw_comparator: Joshua said to the people, “Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do wonders in your midst.”

verses.rationale: Keeps command and fulfillment with the meaningful repetition of the leading position.
verses.before: Then Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant and cross over before the people.” So they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.
verses.after: Then he told the priests, “Lift the ark of the covenant and go ahead of the people.” They lifted it and went ahead of the people.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, “Take up the ark of the covenant and cross over before the people.” So they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.

verses.rationale: Preserves the eyes image, public recognition, and explicit Moses continuity.
verses.before: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
verses.after: The LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, so they will know that I am with you as I was with Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: And the LORD said to Joshua, “Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.

verses.rationale: Keeps the command to stand in the river, not simply beside it.
verses.before: And you will command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, ‘When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, you will stand still in the Jordan.’”
verses.after: Give this command to the priests carrying the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan’s water, stand still in the Jordan.’”
verses.tsw_comparator: And you shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, ‘When you come to the edge of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’”

verses.rationale: Makes the summons direct and preserves listening to divine words.
verses.before: Joshua said to the sons of Israel, “Come near and hear the words of the LORD your God.”
verses.after: Joshua called to the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.”
verses.tsw_comparator: And Joshua said to the sons of Israel, “Come near and hear the words of the LORD your God.”

verses.rationale: Retains emphatic dispossession and all seven peoples; does not soften the promised displacement.
verses.before: Joshua said, “By this you will know that the living God is among you, and that he will surely drive out from before you the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Hivite, the Perizzite, the Girgashite, the Amorite, and the Jebusite.
